Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <7d905l$i0t$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,

Dhar...@yahoo.com wrote:
> Can you play Pulled Fangs on a vampire already going to
> torpor from an aggravated hand strike?

Yes, just like you could play the "old" version on a vampire
that was already going to torpor from an initial Pulled Fangs:

Pulled Fangs - Combat
* Is used when a round ends - after presses, or whenever the round ends
(if it is ended prematurely). [RTR 961113]

--
